name: CIS Microsoft Azure Compute Services Benchmark
note: Each test implements the audit procedure of the recommendation it is mapped to. CIS numbers App Service settings separately for web apps, web app slots, function apps and function app slots; those recommendations are judged only on the findings for their kind of resource (scope). Recommendations that CIS itself marks Manual have no test, except where an existing test reads what the audit asks.
